anti-titin antibodies are present in 20% of patients with thymic epithelioid tumours and that these antibodies are not associated to a specific histology.

1) anti-titin antibodies are associated with the presence of a tumour, 2) anti-titin antibody titres are not associated with the histological subtype of the tumour, 3) the presence of anti-titin antibodies is not associated with a more severe clinical course, 4) anti-titin and AChR antibodies do not coexist in the same patient.
